data.title: ‘F**k Flock!’ Vandals wage war on AI surveillance cameras | CNN
data.description: Flock cameras have sparked a nationwide debate over privacy and public safety. But as cities grapple with the technology, some anti-Flock activists are taking matters into their own hands. CNN’s Meena Duerson sits down with masked activist NoMark to understand what’s driving the growing backlash.
data.author: Aaron Fisher
